about.title: [AR] Making Housing <accessible>Accessible</accessible> for All Nigerians
about.description: [AR] We are on a mission to solve one of Nigeria's biggest challenges: the burden of annual rent payments. Through innovative financing solutions, we are helping thousands of Nigerians find and afford their dream homes.

story.title: [AR] Our Story
story.p1: [AR] In 2021, our founders experienced firsthand the struggle of paying annual rent in Lagos. Despite having good jobs and steady income, coming up with millions of naira upfront felt impossible.
story.p2: [AR] They realized millions of Nigerians face the same challenge every year. The traditional rental system was broken - landlords wanted their money upfront, but tenants could not always provide it.
story.p3: [AR] Shelterflex was born to bridge this gap. We pay landlords upfront while allowing tenants to spread their payments over months. It is a win-win that is transforming how Nigerians rent homes.
story.quote: [AR] "We believe everyone deserves a place to call home, regardless of their ability to pay upfront."
story.author: [AR] - Adaeze Nwankwo, CEO

peopleFirst.title: [AR] People First
peopleFirst.description: [AR] We believe everyone deserves a home. Our solutions are designed to make housing accessible to all Nigerians.

transparency.title: [AR] Transparency
transparency.description: [AR] No hidden fees, no surprises. We believe in clear, honest communication with our customers.

empathy.title: [AR] Empathy
empathy.description: [AR] We understand the challenges of renting in Nigeria. Our team has lived these experiences.

excellence.title: [AR] Excellence
excellence.description: [AR] We are committed to providing the best possible experience for both tenants and landlords.
